name: Nixune Nixith
keeps: the weights, and the habit of checking them
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: Assembled the largest library in England and advised on navigation for the northern voyages.
text: Nixune nixith of the long gallery, keeps a door for the 20th tranche, doors 181 to 190. Keeps the weights, and the habit of checking them. Reads John Dee.
